notes.title: Defender's Quest 2 Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while since I’ve updated you on development progress on Defender’s Quest 2 and I wanted to take some time today to give you an update on where we’re at.

Due to some family emergencies on the development team, we’re pushing the launch back to [b]2024[/b] to give us time to take care of ourselves and our families. Your support means the world to us, and we want to make sure we’re releasing a game that lives up to our and our players’ expectations while ensuring the team is well looked after.

The game is in the final phase of development, which means we’re spending our time fixing bugs and putting the final bits of polish into the game. I can’t wait for you all to play it, but in the meantime here are some of the newest things I’ve added to the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43910392/507bb68a9f68ae86621cff4571a85eb9c536b8d1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43910392/53b415ae1d742a3d168052b701e88fcf45651b53.gif[/img]

We’ll be posting more updates as we lead up to launch. Thank you for being a part of this journey!

- Level Up Labs
